sources.title: Global Switch Annual Report 2025: existing completed data-centre estate at December 31, 2025
sources.source_family: Global Switch original corporate reports and announcements
sources.license: source-terms; compact factual projection only; no open-content licence asserted
sources.summary: The original annual report describes active customer hosting and electricity supply in the existing estate and lists the exact named completed properties separately from developments. Read together, these support the existing facilities' operational state at the December 31, 2025 reporting cutoff. This corrects six dates previously derived from CMS edits; it does not establish a new site, an opening day, completed future phases or any capacity metric.

extraction.date_semantics: The financial statements and investment-property note explicitly report the position at December 31, 2025. The named completed-property table is read with the report's description of actual existing customer hosting, customer electricity consumption and supplied-power recoveries. December 31 is the reporting cutoff for this existing-operation observation, not an inferred opening or commissioning day. The March 13, 2026 director signature, March URL path, retrieval date and website modification dates are not publication or physical-observation dates. Publication day is not established and remains null.

physical_basis.interpretation: The completed-property classification is not used alone as proof of hosting. The same report describes customers using existing data centres, increased actual customer electricity consumption and power-cost recoveries, and operation of multi-customer facilities. The investment-property note is explicitly at the reporting date.
physical_basis.amsterdam_limit: Phase 1 of Amsterdam East completed during 2025; no claim of all planned East phases being operational.

extraction.correction_scope: Existing records only; status values remain operational. Existing geometry, roles, metrics, old source rows and historical snapshots are preserved.
extraction.successor_review: The operator's original annual-report index and corporate announcement index were checked through November 11, together with the April 27 London digital-twin announcement, September 29 Paris announcement and October 6 anniversary account. No newer interim report or site-specific dated physical observation was found for the six annual-report corrections in this bounded review. The October anniversary discusses corporate continuity and historical expansion; it does not establish a new observation for every named property. Current facility descriptions and page modification/sitemap dates are retained only as identity/context. London's live-suite observation is used separately. Paris retains its independently dated existing-operation observation; its future Blackwell deployment and 2027 heat-delivery plan are not completed physical activity. No closure, sale, new commissioned phase or site relocation is inferred. This is a bounded review, not an exhaustive corporate archive or guarantee of continuous service.
